_comment_tax: Set CollectTax true only after Stripe Tax has an Arizona state_sales_tax registration (ADOR TPT). Checkout then uses AutomaticTax + Customer.Shipping (delivery address) for destination sourcing. Rental lines use txcd_99999999; delivery/pickup surcharges use ShippingOptions with txcd_92010001 (Shipping PTC cannot be set on line_items). Defaults to false so tax stays paused until re-enabled.
